legacyPixelIndex.declaredMethod: Hash inventory for earlier explicitly recorded owner pixel attestations. This indexing is not a new visual review and does not infer inspection from file existence. Only unchanged source and matching package revisions are included; clipped revisions excluded.

pixelCoverage.method: Union of current explicit image reviews and separately labeled historical owner attestations. Every listed image hash and its own manifest/source/revision checked. No new visual review inferred from existence.
